claim: The 2025 Q2 period filing puts Meta's total assets at $295 million.
summary: Meta's Q2 2025 total assets were on the order of $295 billion, not $295 million. The stated $295 million figure understates assets by ~1000x due to million vs billion confusion, so the claim is contradicted.

sub_claims.text: Meta has a 2025 Q2 period filing.
sub_claims.note: Meta Platforms is a public SEC registrant that files quarterly 10-Qs; by late 2025 a Q2 2025 filing for quarter ended June 30, 2025 exists.

sub_claims.text: Meta's 2025 Q2 filing puts total assets at $295 million.
sub_claims.note: From general knowledge Meta's total assets in 2025 are on the order of hundreds of billions, approximately $295 billion in mid-2025, not $295 million; the claim is off by a factor of ~1000 due to million vs billion unit error.
